simplePublish.pausedNotice: Further updates paused. Installed or system-submitted installations cannot be undone.
simplePublish.pauseHint: Pausing cannot undo installed or system-submitted installations.
simplePublish.historyHint: Multiple versions may be published. Devices select the highest compatible version. Deleting an uploaded package does not revoke a release.
simplePublish.reportHint: Device-reported status may be stale. Check the received time.
simplePublish.windowsHint: Updates only the LabelFrame Windows client, not Windows or the server. Local installation policy and job protection still apply.
simplePublish.androidHint: Updates only the LabelFrame PDA client, not Android or the server. The PDA user must confirm system installation; jobs are not interrupted.

android.installHint: PDA install note: with the PDA on the same LAN as the server, scan the QR code next to an entry with the camera / scanner app to download. If the first install prompts "unknown sources" or "install blocked", grant the one-time permission: System settings → Apps → Special access (Install unknown apps) → find the browser → allow installing unknown apps; the exact entry point varies by brand (you can also long-press the browser icon → App info → Install unknown apps). For upgrades, use the APK distributed by the same server (matching signature allows a direct overwrite install; configuration and device ID are kept).

androidPublish.refreshRequired: The operation failed or its outcome is unconfirmed. Load the latest releases and device status before acting again; do not immediately repeat publishing.
androidPublish.title: Publish Android updates
androidPublish.hint: APKs above are manual distribution drafts. Publishing verifies the actual package, version, signature and compatibility and creates an immutable snapshot. Devices download in the background; installation requires user confirmation in Android. Silent installation is not available.
androidPublish.scopeHint: Required: device IDs separated by commas or newlines. Empty does not mean all devices.
androidPublish.allConfirm: I confirm publishing to all eligible devices, including future registrations
androidPublish.pauseHint: Pausing blocks subsequent eligibility checks and downloads, but cannot revoke installation already submitted to Android. Publish the same APK again for a new device batch; existing scopes are immutable.
androidPublish.reportHint: Unauthenticated device reports are not live status or trusted health evidence. Reports older than 5 minutes are marked stale. Load again to refresh.

publish.title: Publish client updates
publish.hint: Files above are manual distribution drafts. Publishing validates the real MSI, version, compatibility and pinned publisher. Published content and device scope are immutable; a release can be paused or resumed.
publish.denied: Access denied. Configure a token of at least 32 characters and use HTTPS or access the server locally.
publish.scopeHint: Empty means all devices. Separate IDs with commas or newlines.
publish.reportHint: These are client reports. Check the received time; stale or offline records do not represent live device status.

phases.offline: Connection or download failed; will retry
phases.unsupported: Server does not support automatic updates

reasons.unsaved: Save or discard unsaved edits before installing.
reasons.jobs: Finish or cancel all remaining print jobs before installing.
reasons.results: Wait until all print results have been acknowledged by the server.
reasons.active: Hide the client interface and leave it idle for 10 minutes.
reasons.window: Waiting for the configured local maintenance window.
reasons.ui: Close or refresh other client pages so every page can acknowledge maintenance.
reasons.server: Upgrade the server to enable controlled updates. Manual downloads are still available.
reasons.disconnected: Connect this client to a server before checking for updates.
reasons.noRelease: No published newer release applies to this device.
reasons.eligibility: This release is paused or has changed. Check for updates again.
reasons.reboot: Client updated. Windows requires a later restart; the updater will not restart the operating system.
reasons.restored: Installation failed. The previous version has been restored and printing can continue. Ask an administrator to check the installation log before retrying.
reasons.repair: Recovery checks failed. Printing is paused. Ask an administrator to repair the version, plugins, connection or server registration, then restart the client.
reasons.plugins: Repair or reload installed plugins before continuing with the client update.
reasons.bootstrap: Ask an administrator to install or repair the client update service in Program Files, then retry.
reasons.busy: Another client operation or maintenance action is in progress. Try again after it finishes.
reasons.offline: Check the network and server release status. Background checking will retry automatically.
reasons.draft: The selected draft package no longer exists. Refresh the package list.
reasons.package: The package failed trust, product, version, compatibility or integrity validation. Use a compatible signed client package; published versions cannot be overwritten.
reasons.failed: The update could not proceed. The client remains protected. Check the displayed status and ask an administrator to inspect update logs before retrying.
